Then, for each persona, give the probability THAT group puts on YES once it has heard and absorbed the news. Slowness is modelled separately by the delay, so do not anchor slow groups to the old price: everyone who has heard lands near the fair value, and only a genuine bias (team loyalty, partisanship, wishful thinking) moves a group a few points away.
